hints.title: Cycle Detection and Topological Order
hints.text: If the directed graph contains a directed cycle, paths can be infinitely long; use topological ordering to detect cycles.

hints.title: Color Frequency Table per Node
hints.text: For each node, maintain an array of size 26 tracking the maximum occurrences of each color along any path ending at that node.

hints.title: Topological Dynamic Programming Relaxation
hints.text: When processing node u, relax each outgoing edge u -> v by updating max color counts across all 26 letters.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import deque

class Solution:
    def largestPathValue(self, colors: str, edges: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(colors)
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        in_degree = [0] * n
        for u, v in edges:
            adj[u].append(v)
            in_degree[v] += 1

        q = deque([i for i in range(n) if in_degree[i] == 0])
        dp = [[0] * 26 for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            dp[i][ord(colors[i]) - ord('a')] = 1

        visited = 0
        ans = 0

        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            visited += 1
            ans = max(ans, max(dp[u]))

            for v in adj[u]:
                v_col = ord(colors[v]) - ord('a')
                for c in range(26):
                    cand = dp[u][c] + (1 if c == v_col else 0)
                    if cand > dp[v][c]:
                        dp[v][c] = cand
                in_degree[v] -= 1
                if in_degree[v] == 0:
                    q.append(v)

        return ans if visited == n else -1
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing paths independently takes exponential time in dense directed graphs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Topological sort processes vertices in DAG order, updating 26 color states per edge in O(26*V + E) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate detects cycles via topological queue count and propagates 26 color states.
